patch_description: Keep count four and use radius multiplier 1.1875 for every response. The current recovery condition leaves mean multipliers near 1.25 and produces mixed per-case changes without a clear aggregate gain. A constant 1.1875 tests whether modestly tighter relocation improves tracking while preserving one particle's ordinary PSO motion. This is an untested hypothesis; the persistent interval-end errors do not establish that contraction will help.
